selection: Ten curated author-hosted art packs. This is not a popularity ranking.
content: Metadata only. No artwork, audio, download archive, or generated firmware is included.
compatibility: Each pack requires a user-prepared normalized local sprite folder. Source archive layouts were not extracted or tested.
license_note: Rights summaries reflect author statements. Check the terms accompanying your download and your intended use. Listing a pack does not certify ownership or grant permission.

packs.name: Tappy Plane
packs.author: Kenney
packs.pack_format: Downloadable pack with 75 files. Internal archive layout was not inspected.
packs.adaptation: Map selected aircraft, obstacles, scenery, and UI into the normalized local folder.

packs.name: Flappy Bird Assets: Pixel Art
packs.author: MegaCrash
packs.theme: Pixel birds, colored pipes, and varied scenery
packs.rights: Author lists Creative Commons CC0. Review the work and intended use independently.
packs.pack_format: ZIP pixel pack on a 16-pixel grid. A separate paid vector pack offers SVG and PNG.
packs.adaptation: Choose a player style and environment, select three flight frames, and normalize dimensions and filenames.

packs.name: Little Bird
packs.author: Foozle; commissioned from Baldur for clonethirteen
packs.theme: Small bird with a large sword
packs.rights: Author lists CC0, permits modification and commercial use, and does not require attribution.
packs.pack_format: ZIP containing sprite sheets and Aseprite .ase source, with eleven animations.
packs.adaptation: Select three readable flight frames. Supply separately authorized obstacles, background, and UI.

packs.name: Pixel Art 2D: Flappy Bird-Like
packs.author: DemonStick Games
packs.rights: Author permits free use with credit to PoorGameDev. No standard license identifier is shown. Verify redistribution scope.
packs.pack_format: ZIP with single sprites, sprite sheets, scenery, obstacles, UI, and MP3 audio. Sprites range from 32 by 32 to 270 by 480.
packs.adaptation: Select bat frames, normalize scenery and obstacles, preserve the stated credit, and convert optional audio locally.

packs.name: Tappy Sub
packs.author: MathMage / Mei Bunny
packs.rights: Author permits use and modification with credit. Check the downloaded terms for redistribution scope.
packs.pack_format: Assets.zip with cave layers, rock pillars, submarine, bubble animations, and UI. Bitmap encoding was not inspected.
packs.adaptation: Fit the 38 by 38 submarine and landscape cave layers to the portrait canvas and normalized sprite contract.

packs.name: Flappy AirShip GF/X Asset Pack
packs.author: Mike / pixelbitsnbytes
packs.rights: Author permits creating and selling games using the art and bars reselling the asset package.
packs.pack_format: ZIP with animated 2D graphics, BMFont data, Photoshop layer styles, and LWO/FBX/OBJ source model.
packs.adaptation: Redraw or simplify details intended for at least 1024 by 768 before mapping them onto the small display.

packs.name: Cute Flappy Assets
packs.author: Gufiao Studios / Jovanny Game Dev
packs.rights: Personal and commercial game use allowed. Standalone asset redistribution and resale barred. Attribution is optional.
packs.pack_format: Free ZIP with six individual transparent PNG bird frames and scenery. Premium ZIP adds variants and Adobe Animate .fla source.
packs.adaptation: Choose three flight frames, reduce onto the target grid, and prepare the normalized scenery and UI entries.

packs.name: Flappy Pigeon
packs.author: overcrafted
packs.theme: Pigeon, chicken, penguin, or hen in a city
packs.rights: Paid art pack. The inspected product page does not provide a complete usage license. Obtain and check the accompanying terms before use.
packs.pack_format: Sprites-only ZIP and Unity package. Birds are 16 by 16, pipes 30 by 160, and background about 150 by 250.
packs.adaptation: Confirm usage rights, choose a bird, and normalize character frames, obstacles, scenery, and UI.

packs.name: Pixel Fluffy Birds
packs.author: Yahallo Games
packs.rights: Free version allows noncommercial projects. Paid version allows commercial projects. Both permit edits and bar asset redistribution and resale, including modified assets.
packs.pack_format: Free_Ver0.5.zip and Paid_Ver0.5.zip. Internal image layout was not inspected.
packs.adaptation: Choose the license version for the intended use, select flight frames, and supply normalized environment and UI sprites.

packs.name: Flappy Birds: Pixel Characters 16x16
packs.author: Brysia
packs.theme: Bird species including duck, penguin, raven, toucan, and kiwi
packs.rights: Personal and commercial project use and edits allowed. Sharing and reselling the files barred. Attribution is optional.
packs.pack_format: ZIP of separate 16 by 16 PNG frames, with three flight frames and a death pose for each species.
packs.adaptation: Choose a species, map its three flight frames, and combine it with separately authorized scenery and UI.
